title: Units with zero boundary divisor are nth powers
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field, f : C → Spec k a smooth connected curve, and c : C ↪ X a smooth proper connected compactification [lem-sc-compactification]. Assume X is integral and Noetherian. Let φ : Γ(C,O_C) → k(X) [def-sc-function-field] be a ring homomorphism such that, whenever a germ y at c.i(x) restricts to the germ of a section s at x, φ(s) is the image of y in k(X). For n ≥ 1 and a unit a of Γ(C,O_C), if the restriction of div(φ(a)) [def-sc-divisor] to the closed points outside C is zero, then there exists a unit b of Γ(C,O_C) with b^n = a.

proof.text: Identify φ with the canonical restriction ρ = (c.i.appIso top).inv followed by germToFunctionField on the image open V. Apply germ compatibility at any point x0 of C and the open-immersion germ/appIso identity. Since V is nonempty and c.Z is integral, ρ and therefore φ are injective.

The rational function φ(a) has zero order at points of V because a is a unit. Outside V, a nonzero order would force the point to be closed on the smooth one-dimensional curve (Scheme.isClosed_of_ord_ne_zero), contrary to the zero boundary-divisor hypothesis. Thus its order is zero everywhere. The local DVR criterion and gluing of regular rational functions give a global unit s on c.Z with germ φ(a); implemented by the proved source lemma Scheme.exists_isUnit_germToFunctionField_eq_of_ord_eq_zero.

GlobalSectionsBijective.of_isAlgClosed identifies s with a constant a0 in k. Compatibility of restriction with c.i ≫ c.g = f and injectivity of φ identify the original unit with the restriction κ(a0). Choose b in k with b^n = a0. It is nonzero since a is a unit and n is positive. The unit obtained from κ(b) has nth power a by map_pow and extensionality of units.

theorem boundary_divisor_kernel_powers
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (C : Scheme.{u}) (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f]
    (c : Compactification f) [IsConnectedCurve c.g] [Smooth c.g]
    [IsIntegral c.Z] [IsNoetherian c.Z]
    (φ : Γ(C, ⊤) →+* c.Z.functionField)
    (hφ : ∀ (x : C) (s : Γ(C, ⊤)) (y : c.Z.presheaf.stalk (c.i.base x)),
      c.i.stalkMap x y = C.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial s →
        φ s = algebraMap (c.Z.presheaf.stalk (c.i.base x)) c.Z.functionField y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a : Γ(C, ⊤)ˣ)
    (ha : Finsupp.subtypeDomain (fun P : closedPoints c.Z ↦
      P.val ∉ Set.range c.i.base) (c.Z.div (Additive.ofMul (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom a))) = 0) :
    ∃ b : Γ(C, ⊤)ˣ, b ^ n = a
